claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact BR7.0 two-contact planar allocation, BR7.1 friction and unilateral rejection, BR7.2 support/capture segment and support-loss supervision, and BR7.3 live two-leg planar stance program scopes named by the source-pinned programs; BR7.4 is integrity-only containment and cannot substitute for a milestone program. The unpowered Generic6DOF out-of-plane guide is an explicit material scaffold: sagittal X/Y translation and pitch are released while out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw remain locked, and all guide motors and springs remain off. Two ordinary distal contacts, four paired finite joint actuators, strict non-clamping allocation, whole-system aggregate support and pitch-wrench reconstruction, the declared positive pitch impulse, and the declared right-support removal retain their exact fixture, geometry, mass, timestep, solver, controller, and actuator scopes. Commanded left/right contact shares are not measured per-foot loads. This establishes scaffold-constrained planar height/pitch stance and support-loss detection only, not free 3D standing, unconstrained balance, per-foot measured load allocation, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

programs.claim_scope: The strict two-contact planar allocator exactly realizes declared feasible vertical-force and pitch-moment requests, mirrors signed load redistribution, preserves zero arithmetic residual, and rejects a pulling-contact request without clamping or relabeling commands as measurements.

The exact allocator distributes feasible horizontal force within both declared Coulomb cones and rejects cone overflow, pulling normal load, no-support force, and single-support pitch moments that the remaining point cannot realize.

The declared planar support segment computes exact static and linear-capture margins, predicts mirrored loss direction, degenerates honestly to a point under one support, and emits one reasoned fail-closed support-loss transition without applying force or authorizing guidance.

The declared two-leg fixture regulates planar height and pitch through ordinary distal contacts and paired finite torques, reconstructs aggregate support and pitch wrench from whole-system momentum, recovers the declared positive pitch impulse, and emits one fail-closed event after declared right-support removal while retaining the explicit out-of-plane scaffold.

Integrity-only containment proves that contract mutation, hidden root force or foot pinning, false per-foot measurement, wrong-sign disturbance, missing support-loss evidence, pre-loss infeasibility, and broadened standing or guidance claims fail closed.

does_not_establish: Per-contact, per-foot, or per-toe measured load allocation
An absent, negligible, or measured out-of-plane scaffold reaction
Morphology, terrain, complex-foot, or endurance generalization
Accepted encyclopedia knowledge or automatic creature guidance
